text:
sara-partnerships: Quick sync — CloudScale asked to onboard apac2 (apac-sg-2) to the marketplace this week. They need quota approvals (A100s), KMS entitlements for customer-managed keys, and marketplace SKU activation. can we hit EOD Wed for approvals?

devin-cloudops: what exact SKUs and quantities are they asking for? need partner account ID to open provider ticket.

mike-cloudscale: hey all — partner account: cloudscale-p-993. Initial request: 4 x A100-80GB (dedicated), 8 vGPU profiles for burst, ~120K vGPU hours/month estimate. KMS: customer will bring their CMK, we just need entitlement + IAM role mapping.

sara-partnerships: thanks. rachel, can you validate the vGPU hours vs our Dedicated pool capacity? want to avoid noisy neighbor risk.

rachel-ops: checking real quick. if apac2 uses 4 dedicated A100s steady + burst, we have ~2 spare A100s in pool for that region right now. need autoscale rule to allow burst to shared capacity (cost tier C). I can provision a temporary reserve (30 days) if legal signs off.

anika-legal: what does 'KMS entitlement' mean here? do we require new DPA or is this covered under existing marketplace agreement? also need to confirm region-specific data residency clauses.

mike-cloudscale: we signed the standard marketplace MSA last month. CMK usage was flagged in the partner onboarding checklist as needing entitlements only, no new DPA. but happy to loop legal if you see a red flag.

ben-infra: to open the provider quota request I need this payload (provider accepts JSON):

```
{
  "partner_account": "cloudscale-p-993",
  "region": "apac-sg-2",
  "resources": [
    {"sku": "A100-80GB-dedicated", "count": 4},
    {"sku": "vGPU-burst", "count": 8}
  ],
  "justification": "Marketplace onboarding for CloudScale — estimated 120k vGPU hours/month during steady growth",
  "requested_by": "sara-partnerships"
}
```

ben-infra: I'll paste that into provider support once devin confirms provider account mapping.

devin-cloudops: provider account mapping: PRJ-REDWOOD-APAC2 -> cloudscale-p-993. I'll file the quota ticket after ben pastes payload.

quota-bot: Created ticket #Q-48217 with provider — awaiting provider approval (ETA 48h).

rachel-ops: action items: 1) ben to submit quota ticket (IN PROGRESS), 2) anika to confirm CMK entitlements/legal (ASSIGNED), 3) sara to approve temporary reserve for 30d if needed (PENDING).

sara-partnerships: I'll approve the reserve if legal confirms no extra DPA. mike, timeline from partner end?

mike-cloudscale: partner is ready to go. target public marketplace listing on Mon next week. they can delay listing 48h if needed.

anika-legal: quick note — CMK is fine under current MSA but need to add audit log push to our compliance bucket and a signed consent that partner won't export keys. I'll DM templates to sara.

sara-partnerships: thanks. once ben confirms ticket filed, i'll update the partner and set a canary window for initial traffic. also tagging @rachel-ops for runbook handoff. :thumbsup: 

ben-infra: filed ticket Q-48217 (provider ref PRV-993-2256). provider responded: "Provisioning pending quota capacity review, expected by 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC." pasted provider ref in Jira: PART-7124.

rachel-ops: copying runbook checklist here for canary:
- reserve 30d temporary capacity
- canary traffic 5% for 24h
- monitor latency/error dashboards (model + gateway)
- automatic fallback to euw1 if latency > 400ms for 3min
- post-canary retrospective and cost estimate

sara-partnerships: perfect. I will: 1) confirm reserve approval after legal DM, 2) set partner expectations (can delay 48h), 3) schedule a 15m handoff with ops for Mon morning.

mike-cloudscale: appreciated. sending final SKU confirmation in 10m.

anika-legal: sent consent + audit clause templates to sara. please review and let me know if partner edits.

sara-partnerships: closing loop — next updates: provider quota approval OR provider denial. will post here. thanks everyone! :rocket:
